# test VM

Tests of the tools of the Eve virtual machine, not of the language: slot commands (`v01`–`v06`, `eve -i <file>`) and
the workflow of a command file (`v07`–`v11`, `eve -x -i <file>`). Moved from level 2 by D-072. Command files and
helper scripts are in `slot/`. Run them with `python script/runtest.py vm`.
